title: Creamy Oat Porridge with Banana, Blueberries and Maple
summary: Rolled oats simmered in equal parts milk and water with a little maple syrup and salt, then topped with banana, blueberries and more syrup.
equipment: medium saucepan or large frying pan

ingredients.item: whole milk, plus a splash to serve
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Put the oats, milk, water, 2 tsp maple syrup and salt in the pan. Starting everything cold lets the oats soften evenly as the liquid heats.

steps.title: Simmer and stir
steps.text: Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, then turn to medium and cook for 4-7 min, stirring often, until the oats are tender and a spoon dragged through leaves a trail for a second or two. Stirring releases starch from the oats, which is what makes the porridge creamy.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Take the pan off the heat for 1 min; the porridge keeps thickening as it stands. Loosen with a splash of milk if it is thicker than you like.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into bowls and top with the banana, blueberries, a splash of milk and the remaining maple syrup.

tips: Take it off the heat while it still looks slightly loose; it sets as it cools.
The pinch of salt matters: it brings out the sweetness of the oats.
Use certified gluten-free oats if you need to avoid gluten.
Swap the fruit for toasted nuts, cinnamon or a spoonful of nut butter.
storage: Refrigerate leftovers covered up to 3 days. Reheat in a pan with a splash of milk or water, stirring, until steaming hot (74 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
